description: Required core description, operation, data-presence and embedded-schema behavior. Unless a step states otherwise, messages are authenticated, authorized, correctly addressed, structurally valid apart from the condition under test, and satisfy resource and reference checks. Description exchanges use retained non-conversation request scopes and authorized routes. Conversation traffic uses an established applicable continuity profile with a valid admission guard and retained required context; no turn is open before each independent fresh invocation. Distinct letters identify distinct messages. These abstract traces distinguish actor obligations from requester knowledge and do not establish implementation conformance or an application compatibility promise.

cases.name: distinct exact names are permitted within one description

steps.event: a description declares build and Build as two distinct operation names
expect: accept the otherwise valid description
retain exact string selectors without case folding or name merging
the description confirms its retained describe request

cases.name: identical repeated operation declarations are invalid

steps.event: a description contains two identical declarations named build
expect: refusal malformed for the whole description
do not select the first or last entry or collapse the duplicate
the invalid description does not confirm its describe request

cases.name: conflicting declarations with one name are invalid

steps.event: a description contains two build declarations with different output schemas
expect: refusal malformed for the whole description
do not merge declarations or choose one by array order
signature verification and outer-schema validity do not establish a valid operation set

cases.name: operation-name uniqueness is local to a description

steps.event: actor A and actor B each describe an operation named build with different meanings
expect: both descriptions can be valid
no global operation-name allocation is required

steps.event: A later describes build with a changed contract, with no stronger agreement applying to future turns
expect: the changed declaration is not invalid solely because the name was used before
already admitted turns retain their selected contracts
the new description supplies no automatic authority for an invocation

cases.name: a description confirms only its properly associated request

steps.event: requester retains describe D addressed to actor A in its non-conversation request scope
A sends a valid description naming A and referring to D
expect: accept the description and confirm D
do not confirm another describe or a conversation submission
no conversation context or turn is established

cases.name: an expected signer cannot describe an inconsistent actor name

steps.event: requester retains describe D addressed to A; authenticated A answers D with description.name equal to B
expect: refusal malformed
D is not confirmed by the inconsistent description
the name field cannot substitute another actor's identity

cases.name: another authenticated actor cannot answer the requested actor's describe

steps.event: after earlier route, authentication and addressing checks pass, authenticated B submits a description referring to retained describe D addressed to A
expect: refusal not-authorized
D is not confirmed
a claimed name of A does not replace the authenticated sender

cases.name: description correlation requires the right retained request

steps.event: after earlier guards pass, an otherwise valid description refers to an unknown request in its applicable non-conversation request scope
expect: refusal unknown
do not manufacture a describe request from the response

steps.event: a different description refers to a known message of the wrong kind in that scope
expect: refusal malformed
do not confirm that message as a describe request

cases.name: discovery does not bind a later fresh invocation

steps.event: requester receives description D1 for build; before invocation the actor changes its offering to D2; no stronger agreement applies
fresh say S names build and satisfies the actor's currently selected D2 input
expect: S can open a turn under D2
D1 alone does not require selection of D1
neither a fresh describe nor its receipt eliminates the interval before admission

steps.event: the actor completes S successfully
expect: the result must satisfy the D2 output selected at admission
core does not require permanent meaning for build across future turns

cases.name: an unavailable operation is refused without opening a turn

steps.event: a cached description advertised build, but the actor no longer offers it for fresh requests
fresh say S names build
expect: refusal unsupported
no turn opens and no requested application action is performed
the cached advertisement supplies no availability or authorization guarantee

cases.name: a turn retains its selected contract after the offering changes

steps.event: S opens under build with a selected numeric output schema and declared supplemental contribution rules
a later description changes build to a string output for future requests
permitted contribution C targets S and repeats build
expect: admit C under S's retained contribution rules
do not replace S's contract from the current description

steps.event: the actor completes S successfully
expect: S's result contains data satisfying its selected numeric output
the changed offering does not retroactively redefine the accepted turn

cases.name: an established output mismatch is refused before taken arrives

steps.event: retained applicable agreement establishes that eligible opening S uses output type number; S's taken has not arrived
a first result for S reports succeeded with string data
expect: refusal malformed
the invalid result neither confirms S nor establishes its terminal outcome
do not infer non-execution from refusal of the report

cases.name: an established empty output schema still requires present data

steps.event: retained applicable agreement establishes output {} for eligible opening S
a first succeeded result for S omits data
expect: refusal malformed
absence is not a JSON value satisfying the schema
S is not confirmed by this report

cases.name: unknown selected output does not require waiting for taken

steps.event: requester retains eligible opening S but neither taken nor an applicable output declaration
an otherwise valid consistent succeeded result identifies S
expect: accept the report and confirm S
retain the actor's reported terminal outcome
selected-schema and application compliance may remain unverified
the actor remains obligated to honor its actual selected output

cases.name: an unbound advertisement cannot invalidate a result

steps.event: requester cached a numeric output declaration for build, but no agreement or evidence establishes its applicability to eligible opening S
an otherwise valid consistent result for S contains string data
expect: do not refuse solely for mismatch with the cached declaration
accept the report and confirm S under ordinary receiving rules
do not infer the selected declaration from the returned data

cases.name: later contract evidence does not reverse an accepted report

steps.event: a valid correlated result R was accepted and confirmed S while the applicable output declaration was unknown
later trustworthy evidence establishes that R failed the selected output contract
expect: retain R's acceptance and S's established confirmation
preserve the newly established mismatch without inventing prior validation
do not issue a retroactive refusal or conclude that past execution did not occur
local handling of the additional evidence is infrastructure policy

cases.name: general JSON data travels without mandatory object wrappers

steps.event: an operation declares input {} and output {}; in separate fresh invocations its data values are null, false, 0, empty text, an empty array and an empty object
expect: each present value can satisfy the input declaration
each invocation has its own turn and response contract
the message envelope remains an object

steps.event: each turn succeeds with its corresponding value in result.data
expect: preserve the exact data value and field presence
no universal value wrapper is required
do not omit empty or falsey values

cases.name: missing input and present null have different meanings

steps.event: fresh say S invokes an operation with input {} but omits data
expect: refusal malformed before a turn opens
do not replace absence with null or an empty object

steps.event: fresh say N invokes the same operation with data null
expect: N can open a turn
present null satisfies the empty input schema

cases.name: input validation does not coerce types

steps.event: fresh say S supplies string-valued data "0" to an operation declaring input type number
expect: refusal malformed
do not convert the string to numeric zero
no turn opens

steps.event: fresh say N supplies numeric data 0 to the same operation
expect: N can open a turn
numeric zero is preserved rather than treated as missing

cases.name: data without an opening input schema remains advisory

steps.event: an operation declares guidance but no input schema; a fresh request supplies content and array-valued data
expect: the actor interprets content under the operation contract
data alone does not create binding structured-input semantics
general JSON does not imply a universal merge or execution rule

steps.event: a separate valid fresh request to that operation omits data
expect: omission is permitted
the actor can open a turn without manufacturing a data value

cases.name: defaults and property removal cannot make an input valid

steps.event: input requires count and forbids additional properties; count's schema includes default 1
fresh request S supplies an empty object
expect: refusal malformed
do not insert default count to obtain a match

steps.event: fresh request N supplies count 1 and an undeclared extra property
expect: refusal malformed
do not remove the extra property to obtain a match

cases.name: successful output retains empty and falsey values

steps.event: separate turns select output schemas respectively permitting false, 0, empty text, an empty array and an empty object
the actor succeeds with the corresponding value for each turn
expect: every result contains its data field
serialization preserves the selected value
a requester with established applicable output accepts the otherwise valid result

cases.name: non-success data is not constrained by the success schema

steps.event: eligible opening S has an established output schema requiring an object with completed true
the actor returns failed for S with an explanatory string in data
expect: the success schema does not make the result malformed
accept the otherwise valid report and confirm S
retain the reported failure without inventing completion

steps.event: a separate eligible turn with that output contract ends needs-clarification without data
expect: the success presence requirement does not apply
the otherwise valid terminal report can be accepted

cases.name: an absent output declaration leaves result data optional

steps.event: the selected operation has no output declaration and the actor completes the turn successfully without data
expect: absence of data does not violate the output contract
the result still requires its ordinary status, content and correlation
no empty object or null value is synthesized

cases.name: contributions use their declared input meaning

steps.event: S opens with object input requiring document; its contribution rules separately permit a string-valued constraint
contribution C targets S with string data and omits operation
expect: C can be admitted under the retained contribution rules
do not apply the opening object schema to C
S's output contract is unchanged

steps.event: a different contribution D violates those declared contribution rules
expect: refusal malformed for D
no implicit merge, replacement or independent turn

cases.name: full input replacement requires a complete valid value

steps.event: S's selected input requires document and region; its guidance permits a targeted full replacement
contribution C requests full replacement but omits data
expect: refusal malformed
the prior effective input is unchanged

steps.event: new contribution D supplies only region
expect: refusal malformed
do not merge the missing document from the earlier input

steps.event: new contribution E supplies a complete valid replacement
expect: E can be admitted under the selected contribution rules
the response obligation remains S's original output contract

cases.name: schema roots remain objects while nested boolean schemas work

steps.event: a description's object-form input uses a nested property schema false to forbid that property
expect: the declaration can be valid under draft 2020-12
the nested boolean retains its standard validation meaning

steps.event: a different description supplies false directly as operation.input
expect: refusal malformed
general JSON data does not broaden the object-form schema-root profile

cases.name: local definitions and nested resources can be self-contained

steps.event: an object-form input uses $defs and $ref whose target resolves unambiguously to a schema within that input document
expect: the declaration can be accepted
validate submitted data under the resolved schema
no schema retrieval is performed

steps.event: a separate valid input contains an anchored nested resource and a reference that resolves internally under draft 2020-12
expect: the declaration can be accepted
an internal resource identifier does not require network retrieval

cases.name: meta-invalid embedded schemas invalidate the description

steps.event: an otherwise valid description has operation.input with type equal to numeric 42
expect: refusal malformed for the description
an outer payload-schema pass is insufficient
do not publish or compile the declaration as an implementation-specific dialect

cases.name: the embedded dialect cannot silently vary by validator

steps.event: a valid embedded schema omits $schema
expect: interpret it as the fixed draft 2020-12 profile
do not use the validator library's default dialect

steps.event: a different description explicitly selects draft-07 at its input root or at a nested schema location
expect: refusal malformed
local support for draft-07 does not make it a core operation schema
a nested schema cannot silently switch dialect

cases.name: external schema references cannot trigger retrieval

steps.event: an input contains $ref or $dynamicRef to a resource outside its own schema document
expect: refusal malformed for the description
do not retrieve the target over the network
an application-owned URL or valid signature does not relax self-containment

steps.event: a different declaration refers from input into output or into another operation's schema
expect: refusal malformed
each input and output is an independent schema document

cases.name: unresolved or ambiguous internal references are invalid

steps.event: an input references a missing local $defs entry
expect: refusal malformed for the description
do not defer the missing target into a different dialect or external lookup

steps.event: a separate declaration's internal reference has more than one possible resource target
expect: refusal malformed
do not choose a target by traversal or registration order

cases.name: format and content annotations do not add core assertions

steps.event: an operation input has type string and format email, with no separate application check applying
fresh request S supplies string data that is not an email address
expect: format alone does not make S malformed
the input matches the core schema profile
a validator's optional format assertion mode must not change this result

steps.event: a separate input uses standard content annotations
expect: core schema matching does not require decoding or validating embedded content
separate applicable application checks retain their own meaning

cases.name: unknown schema keywords cannot activate required validation

steps.event: an otherwise valid input declares type number, an unknown keyword positiveOnly true and an embedded $vocabulary naming a custom assertion vocabulary
fresh request S supplies numeric data -1 with no separately applicable application restriction
expect: the unknown keyword does not add a core assertion
embedded $vocabulary does not replace the fixed dialect
the supplied value matches the core schema profile
required additional application meaning needs a separately applicable contract

cases.name: schema validity does not require a satisfying instance

steps.event: a description declares object-form input with not equal to an empty schema
expect: the schema is valid despite rejecting every instance
no general satisfiability proof is required before accepting the description
the application owner remains responsible for a useful offering

steps.event: fresh say S invokes that operation with present data
expect: refusal malformed because the value does not match
no turn opens

cases.name: instance annotations are not traversed as executable schemas

steps.event: an otherwise valid input uses const to require an object containing literal members named $ref and $schema; their values resemble an external reference and another dialect
fresh say S supplies exactly that object
expect: the const value remains instance data
do not fetch its literal $ref or switch dialect from its literal $schema
the value can match and S can open a turn

cases.name: retained accepted copies precede current offering checks

steps.event: S was accepted under build; its exact signed bytes and eligible disposition remain retained in an active authorized scope
build is removed or its current input changes; the original certificate expires
an exact copy of S arrives on an independently authorized route under the still-valid scope guard
expect: return only the fresh minimal acceptance acknowledgement permitted by retained-copy rules
do not reinterpret S against the current offering or input schema
do not re-execute S or return cached application content

cases.name: retained refusal does not become admission after offering changes

steps.event: S was terminally refused as unsupported for an unknown operation, with an eligible retained disposition
the actor now offers that name; an exact copy of S arrives within valid guards and authorized disclosure scope
expect: return the retained unsupported disposition under duplicate rules
do not open a turn or execute the newly available operation
deliberate new work requires a fresh message identity and applicable authority

cases.name: operation interpretation cannot bypass continuity or audience guards

steps.event: a queued request names a valid operation with matching data but its original conversation guard has retired
expect: apply the selected continuity profile's binding rejection
do not open replacement context or perform semantic operation admission
do not reveal a retained disposition through the retired scope

steps.event: a non-conversation description would otherwise match a retained describe but its response route fails the applicable audience guard
expect: apply the binding's audience rejection without protected feedback
valid declaration content does not authorize disclosure or confirmation processing
